name: Apharan
s: Rudra Srivastava, a senior inspector with Uttarakhand police, is lured into kidnapping a young girl at her request. The plot begins as a simple plan to extort money in exchange for her release. When the chain of events go wrong and a series of lies unfold, he realizes that he is now a part of a deadly conspiracy. Will he be able to escape the outcome of his choices or become a victim of the web …

paragraphs.text: Apharan is a 2018 Indian Hindi-language crime thriller streaming television series directed and co-produced by Sidharth Sengupta for video on demand platform ALTBalaji. Starring Arunoday Singh, the series is set in current times and revolves around kidnapping, suspense, mystery and action.
The series has been available for streaming on the ALT Balaji App and its associated websites since its release date. Season 2 was released on 18 March 2022.
